05: SR25519 soft derivation draws a random nonce (schnorrkel 0.9.1 witness_bytes -> thread_rng). For paths whose last junction is soft only privateKey and publicKey are compared and the vector records nonceDeterministic=false (finding F5).
07: Inputs: polkadot-js keyring exports (scrypt + xsalsa20-poly1305 and the legacy padded-password layout) generated offline with the web repo's @polkadot/keyring, plus Fearless JsonSeedEncoder exports written by the production 7508bc83 encoder and by the RC encoder (cross-direction).
Chrome 3.0.5 exports use the same polkadot-js format; they are covered by the polkadot-js inputs. A real-Chromium 3.0.5 export is not part of this run.
12: Each vector is a secret exactly as 4.2.0 (or 3.7.x for V2 chain accounts) stored it, built with the production 7508bc83 crypto and the 4.2.0 schema DSL, together with the durable public identity 4.2.0 recorded. The RC validator must accept every one (signing keeps working; safety invariant 4).
